title: Variance Reduction for Decentralized Stochastic Optimization with Multiple Local Updates
abstract: arXiv:2610.41927v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multiple local updates are widely used in decentralized optimization to enhance communication efficiency, often in conjunction with stochastic gradients when exact gradient computation is costly. However, such algorithms generally converge only to a neighborhood of the optimum, whose size depends on the stepsize and the variance of gradient noise. Variance reduction has been incorporated into ADMM-based methods to achieve exact convergence in expectation, but their stepsizes typically scale inversely with both the square root of the network size and the cube of the number of local updates, leading to slow convergence as the network size or the number of local updates increases. translated_title: 面向多局部更新去中心化随机优化的方差缩减方法
translated_abstract: 多次局部更新被广泛应用于去中心化优化中以提升通信效率，通常在精确梯度计算代价高昂的情况下与随机梯度结合使用。然而，此类算法通常只能收敛到最优解的一个邻域，该邻域的大小取决于步长和梯度噪声的方差。方差缩减技术已被引入基于ADMM的方法中以实现期望意义上的精确收敛，但其步长通常与网络规模的平方根以及局部更新次数的立方成反比，导致随着网络规模或局部更新次数的增加，收敛速度变得缓慢。本文提出了一种新颖的基于原始-对偶框架的去中心化优化算法，该算法将方差缩减与多次局部更新相结合，其步长与网络规模无关，且仅与局部更新次数成反比。
tldr: 本文提出了一种将方差缩减与多次局部更新相结合的原始-对偶去中心化优化算法，其步长与网络规模无关且仅与局部更新次数成反比，克服了现有ADMM类方法因步长受限而随网络规模增大收敛变慢的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel primal-dual decentralized optimization algorithm integrating variance reduction with multiple local updates, achieving a stepsize independent of network size and only inversely proportional to the number of local updates, thereby overcoming the slow convergence of existing ADMM-based methods as network size or the number of local updates grows.
